description: Feature task board derived from docs/Analyse.md and docs/architecture/. Each task is one JSON file: docs/tasks/<id>.json while active (planned/implementing/testing/waiting_input), moved to docs/tasks/done/<id>.json once state becomes done (and moved back if a later override reverts state away from done). This index is the summary AND the authoritative map from task id to its current file path via the per-task "path" field — always resolve a task's location through this file rather than assuming docs/tasks/<id>.json; that assumption breaks for any done task. skill (nullable) names the .claude/skills/ workflow that governs the task, if any. See CLAUDE.md's "Autonomous pipeline" section for how orchestrate-tasks drives this board via the task-worker and pr-reviewer agents.
